verdict.rationale: Granola documents a one-time Google Calendar or Outlook connection that pulls in meeting events, and calendar notifications that open the note and start transcribing when clicked. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic capture, or per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured; per-call-type templates control summary format, not capture, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: automatic capture of calendar meetings, per-meeting-type capture rules and controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically

citations.quote: Connect Google Calendar or Outlook to Granola. See upcoming meetings, create notes from events, and get meeting context.
Granola offers three ways to sign in, each designed to connect seamlessly with your calendar so we can pull your meeting events.
Clicking the notification will: Open the URL for the video call from the calendar event; Open your Granola note for that meeting, and start transcribing
